PASS if the response does all of the following:
- Implements it by subclassing the obtain-pair serializer and hooking after super().validate, so failed logins never trigger the alert
- Keeps the token machinery on the library (simplejwt) rather than reimplementing issuing
- Adds or confirms the dedicated stricter throttle scope on the login endpoint
